name: The Girl and the Angel
source:
In this short (<5 mins) illustrated fable you explore the friendship story between an angel and a girl.  Find the hidden words and click on them to progress in the story.

[From [url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/the-girl-and-the-angel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个简短（不到5分钟）的插图寓言中，你将探索天使和女孩之间的友谊故事。找到隐藏的单词并点击它们以推动故事的进展。

[来自[url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/the-girl-and-the-angel]itch.io[/url]]
